title: Benefit Overpayment Accounts — Waiver Schedule by Classification
content:
This schedule sets the waiver figures for Benefit Overpayment Accounts, classification by classification. A figure of 0 in a percent, share or window column means that the item is not available to that classification.

## Schedule A — Availability and timing

| Classification | Waiver available | Waiver request window (calendar days after the determination date) | Waiver request form mailed with the determination | Offsets, intercepts and billing stop while a waiver request is under review | Business days to decide a request after receipt |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error | Yes | 30 | Yes | Yes | 30 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Employer Reporting Error | Yes | 30 | Yes | Yes | 30 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Appeal Reversal | Yes | 30 | Yes | Yes | 30 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error | No | 0 | No | No | 30 |
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense | No | 0 | No | No | 30 |
| Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense | No | 0 | No | No | 30 |

## Schedule B — Income test figures

| Classification | Full-waiver percent of the poverty guideline | Partial-waiver percent of the poverty guideline | Partial-waiver share of the unpaid principal | One-person poverty guideline (USD per year) | Added for each additional household member (USD per year) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error | 200 | 250 | 0.50 (50 percent) | 15650.00 | 5500.00 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Employer Reporting Error | 200 | 250 | 0.50 (50 percent) | 15650.00 | 5500.00 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Appeal Reversal | 200 | 250 | 0.50 (50 percent) | 15650.00 | 5500.00 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error | 0 | 0 | 0 | 15650.00 | 5500.00 |
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense | 0 | 0 | 0 | 15650.00 | 5500.00 |
| Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense | 0 | 0 | 0 | 15650.00 | 5500.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

- The full-waiver percent is the annual household income, as a percent of the federal poverty guideline for the household size, at or below which the whole unpaid principal is waived; the partial-waiver percent is the percent at or below which a partial waiver is granted; the partial-waiver share is the share of the unpaid principal a partial waiver forgives.
- The poverty guideline used by the income test is the one-person figure, with the per-member figure added for each household member beyond the first.
- The three non-fraud classifications without fault on the claimant's part are the classifications for which waiver is available. For the other three classifications every waiver figure reads 0 or No.

## Reading the schedule

**What is the poverty guideline for a household of four under this schedule?** The one-person figure of USD 15650.00 plus three additional members at USD 5500.00 each, which is USD 32150.00 per year.

**Does a request on a Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error account have a window?** No. Its window is 0, which means waiver is not available to that classification.
